description: This file defines internal data structures, macros, and inline functions for the CAN Network Management (CanNm) module in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform. It includes error reporting, validation macros, enum and struct definitions, and helper function prototypes related to CAN network management channels.

methods.name: CanNm_Internal_TickTimeoutTime

methods.name: CanNm_Internal_TickMessageCycleTime

methods.name: CanNm_Internal_ClearCbv

methods.name: CanNm_Internal_TransmitMessage

methods.name: CanNm_Internal_GetUserDataLength
